citations.assessment: Rav Idi institutes daytime immersion on the eighth day at Naresh because of lions.
The explicit primary chain is Rabbi Idi transmitting Yehoshua ben Levi’s rule for measuring the Sabbath limit.
The next segment gives Idi’s own characterization and question about the midpoint and endpoint.
Ri explains the formula as praise for the precision of the distinction and compares the phrase with other instances.
The matching digital chain appears in halakhah 2, segment 7, with Rabbi Idi, Rav Hamnuna and Rav Adda bar [Achua] transmitting in Rav’s name. Heilprin supplies a different locator and sequence.
